facts.F1: ADO Story #6625 (unparented, follow-up of Closed Epic #5878 Baseline). Make creating a Baseline Then / Now report intuitive, from user feedback (Nick Brown): Then and Now can differ in length (30 vs 45 days), a Then ending today leaves no room for a Now, delete is hard to find, Throughput is not compared. Maintainer direction: Now always has the same length as Then. Out of scope: the shown metric set (Story #6649). DISCOVER and DIVERGE skipped by the maintainer 2026-11-15.

facts.F100: Carriers and owners: the value object ReportWindow (Models/Reports/ThenAndNowPayload.cs) gains NowEndingOn(today), so a Now window can only be built from a Then window and cannot take another length. The pure static ReportWindowPolicy (Services/Implementation/Reports/ReportWindowPolicy.cs) owns window refusals: NowLengthRefusal(requestedNowLengthDays, thenLengthDays) replaces NowRefusal and NowWindow. ReportRefusalCodes gains now-length-differs-from-then; now-too-short, now-too-long and now-before-cutoff stay as constants because their spelling is a client contract, but are no longer emitted. ThenAndNowTemplate stays the template that freezes, edits and reads, and delegates every window decision to those two owners. Errors stay ReportOutcome Refused(code), mapped to 400 ProblemDetails by ReportsControllerBase; a stale save stays 409.
facts.F101: Cross-layer algebra. Domain: states are a frozen Then window (start, end, length) and a Now window derived per day; operations EndingOn, NowEndingOn, ThenRefusal, NowLengthRefusal; observation is the read model thenWindow and nowWindow. Application: Create and Edit return Done or Refused(code); Edit returns stale (409) only after a real concurrent save. Adapter: refusal codes map to 400 ProblemDetails, unchanged. Infrastructure: no change, no migration, no recovery path added.
facts.F102: Claim-to-checker: the state and request claims (Now length equals Then length on every read; accepted requests carry no Now or an equal one; no stale refusal from the deploy; Edit never refused for kept history; a valid Then implies a Now inside kept history; Total and per-day changes never opposed with equal lengths) are checked with Quint (state model, quint run simulation with behavioural mutants) in docs/feature/story-6625-baseline-report-creation/evidence/quint/design.qnt. The window-relation and total-line claims reuse the DISCUSS model evidence/quint/baseline.qnt. Agda is not selected: no general theorem beyond these finite rules is claimed. TLA+/TLC is not selected: there is no temporal or fairness claim.
facts.F103: Liveness is not applicable: every create, edit and read is a synchronous request answered once, and no claim promises eventual progress. The daily movement of Now follows the instance clock, not a system process.
facts.F104: Second stressor walk over the finished design (walkthrough, not execution): the day changes while the wizard is open (today comes from the keyed templates query refetched each time the wizard opens, and the server derives Now at create, so the saved report is still equal length); the oldest kept day moves later after creation (Then is frozen and Edit never re-checks it, P8); a client sends nowLengthDays 0 or a negative value (not equal to Then, refused with the same code); a payload written by a later version carries unknown members (Edit still edits the JSON tree and writes nothing about windows). None showed a new residue.
facts.F105: Test substrate. Backend: new acceptance scenarios at the application-service port in Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Acceptance/BaselineReportCreation/ (namespace Lighthouse.Backend.Tests.Acceptance.BaselineReportCreation), built with ServicePortHarness and FakeLighthouseClock; no new host test. Frontend: Vitest with React Testing Library; rules on functions in .test.ts files, one render per wiring in .test.tsx files. The Lighthouse test-writing skill wins over nWave per-test timing and PBT-density rules. Mutation: new configs Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/stryker.6625.backend.json (ReportWindowPolicy, ReportWindow, ThenAndNowTemplate; its test-case filter names Tests.Acceptance.BaselineReportCreation) and Lighthouse.Frontend/stryker.6625.frontend.json (thenAndNowDraft.ts, reportWindowCheck.ts, thenNowComparison.ts, ThroughputPanel.tsx), run once on frozen code, 80 percent kill minimum.
